n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Can you ring the surgery for me? I'm driving. Ask to speak to the nurse about William's injections.

translations.fa: می‌تونی برام به مطب زنگ بزنی؟ دارم رانندگی می‌کنم. بخواه با پرستار دربارهٔ واکسن‌های ویلیام صحبت کنی.

branches.suggestion: Sure. Is the number on the fridge?

cultureNote.en: In Britain, a "surgery" is a doctor's office, not only an operation.

n2.speaker: receptionist
n2.text: Good morning, Mare Street Surgery. Tracy speaking. How can I help?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر، مطب مِر استریت. تریسی هستم. چطور کمک کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Good morning. Can I speak to the nurse, please?
branches.suggestionFa: صبح بخیر. می‌تونم با پرستار صحبت کنم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Hello. I'm calling about William Thompson.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام. دربارهٔ ویلیام تامپسون زنگ می‌زنم.

recasts.better: Can I speak to the nurse, please?

n3.speaker: receptionist
n3.text: I'm sorry, the nurse is busy at the moment. Can I take a message?

translations.fa: متأسفم، پرستار الان مشغوله. می‌تونم پیغام بگیرم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. It's about William's injections.

n4.speaker: receptionist
n4.text: How old is William? And what's his date of birth?

translations.fa: ویلیام چند سالشه؟ و تاریخ تولدش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: He's three. Let me ask his mum.
branches.suggestionFa: سه سالشه. بذار از مامانش بپرسم.

branches.suggestion: He's three years old. His mum is here.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Tell her the fifth of March! Three years ago!

translations.fa: بهش بگو پنجم مارس! سه سال پیش!

branches.suggestion: The fifth of March, three years ago.
His birthday is the fifth of March.

n6.speaker: receptionist
n6.text: Thank you. William needs his pre-school jabs. I can book an appointment for you.

translations.fa: ممنون. ویلیام واکسن‌های قبل از مدرسه‌اش را لازم داره. می‌تونم براتون وقت بگیرم.

cultureNote.en: Brits often say "jabs" for vaccinations. UK children have free vaccinations on the NHS.

n7.speaker: receptionist
n7.text: Next Tuesday at half past ten, with Nurse Adeyemi. Is that OK?

translations.fa: سه‌شنبهٔ بعد ساعت ده و نیم، با پرستار آدِیمی. خوبه؟

branches.suggestion: Tuesday at ten thirty. Is that OK, Leslie?
branches.suggestionFa: سه‌شنبه ده و نیم. خوبه لزلی؟

branches.suggestion: Can you repeat the time, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه ساعت را تکرار کنید، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: That's fine. Thank you very much.

n9.speaker: receptionist
n9.text: You're welcome. We'll send a text to remind you. Bye now!

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم. یه پیامک یادآوری می‌فرستیم. خداحافظ!
